titles.title: Special #7

description: Two long, thin shapes that curve downward at their tops hover at the center of the canvas. Rippling stripes float on either side of the thin forms. All of the elements are drawn in shades of gray and black and contrast with the plain white surface of the paper surrounding them.
imageCaption: Courtesy of National Gallery of Art.
title: No. 7 Special
